answer: No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 14 identities per epoch. Audits are logged in wander, queued in lantern, and relic publishes the wait time. A farm of 289 fresh keys hence waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. A farm of 4309 identities would post 2321 proofs and burn roughly 23 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
